opsx:propose.description: Propose a new change - create it and generate all artifacts in one step

opsx:apply.description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change (Experimental)

opsx:archive.description: Archive a completed change in the experimental workflow

opsx:explore.description: Enter explore mode - think through ideas, investigate problems, clarify requirements

opsx:sync.description: Sync delta specs from a change to main specs

opsx:update.description: Update a change - revise existing planning artifacts and keep them coherent (Experimental)

opsx:flow.description: Run the full OpenSpec lifecycle — propose, apply, archive — with git checkpoints between steps
